inputs.name: document
inputs.description: A French energy performance diagnostic (DPE) of a dwelling, as a PDF

output.description: The key figures of a French energy performance diagnostic (DPE) of a dwelling

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address of the dwelling the diagnostic is about, not the owner's address

fields.name: date_of_issue
fields.description: The date the DPE was issued ("Etabli le")

fields.name: date_of_expiration
fields.description: The date the DPE expires ("Valable jusqu'au")

fields.name: energy_efficiency_class
fields.description: The energy performance class, read on the energy consumption scale

fields.name: per_year_per_m2_consumption
fields.description: Primary energy consumption, in kWh per m² per year

fields.name: co2_emission_class
fields.description: The greenhouse gas emission class, read on the CO₂ emissions scale, which is separate from the energy scale

fields.name: per_year_per_m2_co2_emissions
fields.description: Greenhouse gas emissions, in kg of CO₂ per m² per year, not the dwelling's yearly total

fields.name: yearly_energy_costs_min
fields.description: The low end of the estimated yearly energy costs, in euros

fields.name: yearly_energy_costs_max
fields.description: The high end of the estimated yearly energy costs, in euros
